title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Bulevardi i Ri, Tiranë
description_sq:
Apartament 2+1+2 +Post Parkimi ne Shitje
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 tek Rezidenca Globe 3X, Bulevardi i Ri.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne kati e 5 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor ne nje nga zonat me ne zhvillim te kryeqytetit.
Organizohet nga korridori shperndares i ambienteve, sonxhorno e bollshne bashke me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 1 ballkon.
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje ndertimi te ri me punime teper cilesore dhe bashkekohore, fasade te ventiluar, kondicionim qendror etj.
Apartamenti ka punime ekstra, tavane te varura, dysheme me parket etj.
Apartamenti eshte ne fazen e punimeve perfundimtare dhe behet gati per banim me Prill 2026.
Per me shume info ose vizite ne prone na kontaktoni

description_en: 2+1+2 Apartment + Parking Post for Sale 2+1+2 apartment for sale at Rezidenca Globe 3X, New Boulevard. It is organized by a distribution corridor, spacious living room with kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 1 balcony. The apartment is part of a new building with high-quality and contemporary works, ventilated facade, central air conditioning, etc. The apartment has extra works, suspended ceilings, parquet floors, etc. The apartment is in the stage of final works and will be ready for occupancy in April 2026.
